mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM preparation_item WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id} AND kind='TARGET')
mapper.sql: i.id,i.kind,d.title,i.status,i.metadata_revision AS item_revision, i.current_version_id,d.revision AS draft_revision,d.saved_at AS draft_saved_at, (NOT (CAST(d.title AS BINARY) <=> CAST(v.title AS BINARY)) OR NOT (CAST(d.body AS BINARY) <=> CAST(v.body AS BINARY))) AS unpublished_draft, (d.item_id IS NOT NULL AND v.id IS NOT NULL) AS complete, COALESCE(pl.order_value,500000) AS order_value,pl.planned_date AS placement_date

FROM knowledge_item i LEFT JOIN knowledge_draft d ON d.item_id=i.id LEFT JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.id AND v.id=i.current_version_id LEFT JOIN today_placement pl ON pl.owner_id=i.owner_id AND pl.source_kind='KNOWLEDGE_DRAFT' AND pl.source_id=i.id

s.id,s.title,s.mode,s.status,s.revision,s.generation,s.updated_at,s.question_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_question d WHERE d.owner_id=s.owner_id AND d.session_id=s.id AND d.draft_json IS NOT NULL) AS saved_draft_count, (SELECT MAX(d.draft_saved_at) FROM training_question d WHERE d.owner_id=s.owner_id AND d.session_id=s.id AND d.draft_json IS NOT NULL) AS last_draft_saved_at, GREATEST(s.updated_at,COALESCE((SELECT MAX(d.draft_saved_at) FROM training_question d WHERE d.owner_id=s.owner_id AND d.session_id=s.id AND d.draft_json IS NOT NULL),s.updated_at)) AS last_activity_at, (SELECT r.id FROM review_repractice r WHERE r.owner_id=s.owner_id AND r.session_id=s.id) AS repractice_id, COALESCE(pl.order_value,500000) AS order_value,pl.planned_date AS placement_date
FROM training_session s LEFT JOIN today_placement pl ON pl.owner_id=s.owner_id AND pl.source_kind='TRAINING_SESSION' AND pl.source_id=s.id
mapper.select: SELECT session_id,id,revision,status,(draft_json IS NOT NULL) AS has_draft,draft_saved_at, latest_answer_id,answer_count,position_index FROM training_question WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND session_id IN #{id} ORDER BY session_id,position_index,id

SELECT s.id AS source_id,t.item_id,t.version_id FROM training_session s JOIN JSON_TABLE(s.context_json,'$[*]' COLUMNS(source_kind VARCHAR(16) PATH '$.kind', item_id VARCHAR(36) PATH '$.itemId',version_id VARCHAR(36) PATH '$.versionId')) t ON t.source_kind='TARGET' WHERE s.owner_id=#{owner} AND s.id IN #{id} ORDER BY s.id,t.item_id,t.version_id
mapper.sql: FROM preparation_task t LEFT JOIN today_placement pl ON pl.owner_id=t.owner_id AND pl.source_kind='PREPARATION_TASK' AND pl.source_id=t.id
FROM review_action a LEFT JOIN today_placement pl ON pl.owner_id=a.owner_id AND pl.source_kind='REVIEW_ACTION' AND pl.source_id=a.id
FROM interview_event e LEFT JOIN today_placement pl ON pl.owner_id=e.owner_id AND pl.source_kind='INTERVIEW_EVENT' AND pl.source_id=e.id
